about: Batch 1 was written early, with art_batch.py 1 --preview, on 7 Oct 2026, at the owner's word,
and run by the owner while the agent build waited (docs/UI2_DESIGN.md 10.2, the art sittings; risk 50).
art_1.json beside this file is the workflow that was run (its note names the folder it was run from).
At batch 0's sitting art_batch.py 1 is written as planned and compared with these rows:
a picture whose prompt and references are byte for byte the same keeps its early renders;

chosen.said: the owner, in chat, 7 Oct 2026: "B, A, B" (after "I think B is better" and "I lied, A is better"), in the order the sitting lists its pictures

school_yard.note: the render came back with a black strip 131 px wide on its right edge; ui2_school_yard_b_fit.png is the same render with 136 px cut from the right and 64 px of sky from the top (2616x1472, still 16:9 and still larger than the game's 1920x1080). The fitted file is the one to install.

dorm_yard.note: OPEN, the owner's to decide: this version shows a five-storey pagoda beyond the girls' dormitory (north-east of the garden). The chosen Courtyard fixed the pagoda behind the schoolhouse's north end, which from this camera is behind me. Either the campus has a second pagoda (the record gains a landmark fixed by this picture; nothing is run), or the pagoda is taken out of this picture by one named change (two renders). Not installable until that is settled.

training_yard.note: read by eye against its five-line checklist: all yes (no vending machine, no shoe lockers; the training hall on the left; the paved passage at the bottom left; the storehouse ahead beyond the posts; the walled steps right of it; the dojo and the roofed gate to the pool on the right).

not_yet: Nothing is installed. check_layout.py does not exist yet (U0d3); the pass rule of plan 5.2 is applied at the layout sitting, after checkpoint A.
